title: #083. Epsilon-Constraint Pareto Frontier
subtitle: Trace the exact profit-vs-emissions Pareto curve across emission thresholds, including non-convex integer frontier points.

judge.m0: Output must be an object { selections, frontierProfits, frontierSum }.
judge.m1: Field "selections" must be an array of length {p0}.
judge.m3: Frontier point {p0} uses budget {p1}, exceeding budgetCap {p2}.
judge.m4: Frontier point {p0} emits {p1}, exceeding cap epsilons[{p0}] = {p2}.
judge.m5: frontierProfits[{p0}] ({p1}) does not match selected profit ({p2}).
judge.m6: Reported frontierSum ({p0}) does not match sum of frontierProfits ({p1}).
judge.m7: All frontier points are feasible, but frontierSum ({p0}) is below exact Pareto sum ({p1}).
